purpose: test whether DAMON proactive reclamation causes natural directory-scan variation
baseline: official fixed image and guest kernel; existing default DAMON remains enabled

variants.default: do not change the guest DAMON setting
variants.damon_disabled: write N only to this run-owned guest /sys/module/damon_reclaim/parameters/enabled immediately after create, before uploads and frequency wait; bound wait for kdamond_pid=-1

measurement: use calibrated vmstat/meminfo and root device endpoints, add-native Trace2 and owned-vCPU wait/KVM counters; do not enable the two rejected DAMON statistics collectors
gate: smoke correctness, guest enabled/worker-state check, exact action/stdout/patch hashes, targeted functional checks, CPU restore, project resource cleanup and offline audit must pass before four-run comparison
cleanup: delete only newly created owned VMs; no template or shared service setting changes; guest parameter disappears with VM deletion
limits: separate diagnostic variation, not replacement of official baseline
four replays do not establish monitoring confidence interval or fairness of memory comparison
approval_reason: The local AGENTS.md requires discussion of important changes affecting research conclusions; changing guest cache policy needs explicit agreement on the separate comparison group

followup.user_authorization: 按照你的计划继续实验，等到有重要事项需要汇报讨论再停下。
followup.gate: reuse prior passed smoke; offline audit and cleanup after each group; no protocol change besides order
followup.stop_rule: after an audited group: disabled scan >=100 ms, any correctness/state/cleanup error or disk risk; after two audited groups: default scan >=200 ms; otherwise stop at three groups
followup.stop_rule_scope: descriptive diagnosis only; optional stopping, no formal statistical inference
followup.baseline_policy: retain official default, no cache clearing or prewarming
followup.stop_reason: MAXIMUM_THREE_GROUPS_REACHED; neither >=200ms default nor >=100ms disabled scan occurred
followup.next_step: time runner preparation and final patch phases outside frozen actions; then assess monitoring separately under each explicit DAMON policy, preserving official default

runner_phase_diagnosis.calibration_scope: 256 measured fixture calls plus 32 warmup; new guest DAMON disabled, no cache flush
runner_phase_diagnosis.purpose: locate setup/finalization and control-channel residual without changing frozen actions
runner_phase_diagnosis.stop_rule: stop on calibration rejection, first failed correctness/state/audit/cleanup boundary or disk risk; otherwise audit smoke before four-run comparison
runner_phase_diagnosis.next_step: calibrate and time individual initial git add/write-tree/reset/rev-parse subcommands; preserve frozen actions and existing whole-task metric; no formal monitoring acceptance yet

baseline_command_diagnosis.purpose: split original initial Git preparation into add/write-tree/reset/rev-parse wall and CPU times
baseline_command_diagnosis.calibration: 32 warmup plus 8x32 measured warm-fixture calls; DAMON disabled, existing runner phases in both groups; incremental new command records only
baseline_command_diagnosis.gate: calibration abs AA <=5 and AB <=5 for both elapsed scopes; smoke correctness/state/cleanup/offline audit before four replays
baseline_command_diagnosis.limits: no frozen action or primary whole-task metric change; no cache flush; descriptive diagnostics only, no 5% monitoring acceptance
baseline_command_diagnosis.stop_reason: MAXIMUM_SIX_REPLAYS_REACHED; initial add accounts for about 97% of baseline preparation; correctness, state and cleanup passed
baseline_command_diagnosis.next_step: calibrate native tracing of initial add internals and bounded I/O records before further replays; preserve official default and whole-task metric; no monitoring acceptance

baseline_add_trace_diagnosis.purpose: locate initial add internal regions and guest block I/O deltas
baseline_add_trace_diagnosis.calibration: 32 warmup plus 8x32 warm-fixture calls; DAMON disabled; existing phase and Git command timers in both groups; only new native trace and diskstats differ
baseline_add_trace_diagnosis.gate: abs AA <=5% and AB <=5% for both elapsed scopes; audit smoke before comparison
baseline_add_trace_diagnosis.limits: no frozen action change, cache flush or prewarming; block counters are guest device-wide, nested Git timers are not additive; no monitoring acceptance
baseline_add_trace_diagnosis.stop_rule: stop on first calibration rejection, correctness/state/cleanup error or disk risk; otherwise stop after six full replays and offline audit
baseline_add_trace_diagnosis.stop_reason: Six replays completed; initial diff-files accounts for 91-92% of add with about 68 MiB root-device reads; default step 025 again reached 322 ms while disabled scans stayed near 30 ms
baseline_add_trace_diagnosis.next_step: inspect initial index stat metadata versus file attributes in a separate bounded fixture; test why initial diff-files reads contents; then assess monitoring within explicit cache policies using same-batch controls; retain official default and whole-task metric

initial_index_diagnosis.purpose: test index stat mismatch versus repeated content validation without changing file contents
initial_index_diagnosis.limits: independent intervention diagnosis; metadata inspection before first add; no natural replay timing or monitoring acceptance; no cache flush
initial_index_diagnosis.gate: local fixture passed; finish and audit first guest before second; all tree/object/state/CPU restoration/cleanup checks required
initial_index_diagnosis.next_step: retain complete per-file stat rows; test stat refresh only for unchanged objects without adding Dockerfile or staging package.json early; preserve original whole-task baseline and treat any normalization as a separate variant
initial_index_diagnosis.stop_reason: Maximum two guests reached; original index stat differs on all 8261 entries, 8260 file objects unchanged; disabled warm original add 393-402ms versus updated 38-40ms, all trees identical

monitoring_return_to_original_replay.purpose: retest periodic monitoring with original frozen guest runner and initial index; preserve complete preparation costs
monitoring_return_to_original_replay.balanced_policy: damon_disabled; official default retained as independent smoke, never pooled
monitoring_return_to_original_replay.schedule: same-batch control_A/control_B both off and off/light; randomized four labels then mirror
monitoring_return_to_original_replay.primary_metric: task_window_ns includes sampler startup/stop and all initial preparation; no deductions
monitoring_return_to_original_replay.sampling: host service cgroup every 1 second; guest periodic sampling disabled
monitoring_return_to_original_replay.limits: same fixed image, 2 vCPU, 4096 MiB, requested 2 GHz and vCPU 2/4; no BPF/Git diagnostic, cache flush, prewarm or index refresh; shared CPUs
monitoring_return_to_original_replay.gate: correctness, targeted functional checks, original guest hash, three DAMON boundaries, CPU restoration, cleanup and offline audit after smoke and every group
monitoring_return_to_original_replay.decision: only five complete groups allow original 95% t log-ratio rule: off/off interval within [-5,+5], monitor upper bound <=+5; early stop is descriptive, not statistical acceptance
monitoring_return_to_original_replay.stop_rule: first correctness/state/cleanup failure or disk risk; after first balanced group, stop for important baseline variability if absolute off/off group difference exceeds 5%; otherwise complete up to five groups then report conclusion
monitoring_return_to_original_replay.disk: start >=32 GiB, stop <20 GiB; shared writer lock, quarter-second checks; owned VM cleanup after each run; raw data retained without per-run image archive
monitoring_return_to_original_replay.stop_reason: Five complete groups passed declared 95% interval rule for original replay with DAMON disabled and host-only 1Hz sampling; bounded total 48 replays reached; important scoped acceptance result
monitoring_return_to_original_replay.next_step: Keep this measured profile explicit; assess default policy separately without pooling; then TrEnv-X same-batch controls after preparing bounded disk retention, plus clean-directory reproduction of selected configuration; no blanket 5% acceptance for all collectors

initial_index_stat_only_diagnosis.purpose: refresh unchanged-file stat records while preserving original staged paths, modes, OIDs and stages; retain full per-file attributes
initial_index_stat_only_diagnosis.gate: three local regression tests and historical offline audit passed; first guest correctness/state/CPU restoration/cleanup before second
initial_index_stat_only_diagnosis.limits: independent intervention only, no frozen trajectory, no cache flush; metadata inspection and first add warm caches; refresh cost recorded separately, not excluded from any future end-to-end variant
initial_index_stat_only_diagnosis.stop_rule: stop on first failure or disk guard; otherwise stop at two guests and ten calls for audit and important findings
initial_index_stat_only_diagnosis.stop_reason: Important finding: all 8261 staged paths/modes/OIDs/stages preserved; unchanged-file refresh reduces warm add from 389-410ms to 44-47ms, diff-files to 0.4-0.6ms; refresh itself costs 355/591ms; maximum two guests reached
initial_index_stat_only_diagnosis.next_step: Return to complete frozen replay monitoring comparison, preserving original index and all initial preparation cost; bounded off/light smoke within authorized DAMON-disabled policy, official default separate; retain same-batch AA controls and mirrored order before five-group inference; no early index refresh as baseline replacement

monitoring_default_policy.purpose: evaluate official default DAMON policy separately with original frozen replay and complete preparation cost
monitoring_default_policy.primary_metric: task_window_ns; includes sampler startup/stop, original initial index and complete preparation
monitoring_default_policy.sampling: host service cgroup 1Hz; guest periodic sampling disabled
monitoring_default_policy.settings: same fixed image; 2 vCPU/4096 MiB; vCPU 2/4; authorized four CPU 2 GHz request and restoration; DAMON remains enabled
monitoring_default_policy.schedule: same-batch control_A/control_B both off plus off/light; randomized four labels then mirror; same seeds as disabled groups, separately analyzed
monitoring_default_policy.gate: reuse passed default smoke; first balanced group must pass correctness, state, original guest hash, functional checks, CPU restoration, cleanup and offline audit before extension
monitoring_default_policy.decision: only five complete groups allow original 95% t log-ratio rule: off/off interval within [-5,+5], monitor upper bound <=+5; early stop is descriptive, not statistical acceptance
monitoring_default_policy.stop_rule: first correctness/state/cleanup error or disk risk; after first balanced group stop and report if abs(off/off difference)>5%; otherwise finish five groups for declared t intervals; no extra groups
monitoring_default_policy.disk: start >=32 GiB, stop <20 GiB; shared writer lock, quarter-second checks; owned VM cleanup after each run; raw data retained without per-run image archive
monitoring_default_policy.limits: no Git/BPF tracing, cache clearing/prewarming or index refresh; no pooling with DAMON-disabled groups; shared CPUs; only 1Hz host sampling acceptance
monitoring_default_policy.stop_reason: Five planned default-policy groups completed; monitor upper 95% bound +3.02% but off/off interval [-6.33,+1.40] outside equivalence range; stop at 40 new replays, no extra groups or discarded slow calls
monitoring_default_policy.next_step: Preserve official default baseline as separate inconclusive group and disabled-policy accepted profile; prepare bounded TrEnv-X image retention before same-batch controls, then selected-profile clean-directory reproduction including checkpoint; no extra default repetitions without a new hypothesis/protocol
